stewards_excuse: Jumped only fairly. Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between SUPERB SPIRIT and HAR HAR POWER, both of which shifted ground. B Avdulla (AKASHVANI) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 900 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of FIT FOR BEAUTY, resulting in FIT FOR BEAUTY being taken in onto SUPERB SPIRIT, resulting in SUPERB SPIRIT losing its running and having to be steadied and also shifting in and crowding the running of PASS LINE, causing PASS LINE to be checked. B Avdulla was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 18 November 2026 at Happy Valley. In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record. Bumped near the 50 Metres.
note: jumped fairly then squeezed after the start between Superb Spirit and Har Har Power; checked again near 900m in the same chain
